values.note: $15 per single site per night, $5 each additional vehicle. Fees are charged Memorial Day to Labor Day.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/emerald-lake-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night Additional Vehicle: $5 per night', 'Fees charged Memorial Day – Labor Day'; last updated July 28, 2026), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/emerald-lake-campground ('1/2 price fees with Interagency Senior or Access Pass'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No reservation system; first come, first served. 'Very popular and may fill up on weekends & holidays during the summer months' - arrive early.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/emerald-lake-campground ('This campground does not use a reservation system. First-come, first-served ... There is a 16 day stay limit.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Open year-round. Fees charged Memorial Day – Labor Day. Full service, reduced services in shoulder season.'
No host. Central bear-resistant dumpster; some sites have bear-resistant food lockers. No firewood sold.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/emerald-lake-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'; 'Host : No'; 'Trash Pickup: Centrally located Bear resistant dumpster'; 'Some sites are equipped with bear resistant food storage lockers'), read 2026-10-22

note: Forest Service campground in the West Rosebud drainage of the Beartooths, 34 miles west of Red Lodge via MT-78 and 419 (19 miles south of Fishtail on West Rosebud Rd), in the trees between Emerald Lake and West Rosebud Lake. West Rosebud Trail nearby. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the FS page (updated July 2026): $15 + $5 extra vehicle, FCFS only, 16-day limit, 32 sites, 30-ft trailers, vault toilets, potable water, half price with Senior/Access pass. Added season (open year-round, fees Memorial Day - Labor Day). The Pine Grove closure alert in the same drainage does not name Emerald Lake or the road. Note trimmed of restated values.
